disagreement.independent_candidate: Yield was estimated from the visible knee near 80 kN and 1.0 mm, giving about 400 MPa.
disagreement.legacy_candidate: Uses a 0.2% offset parallel to the initial slope and reads Fy about 97.53 kN, giving about 487.7 MPa.

source_review.finding: The curve has no explicit yield plateau. The offset construction is the defensible method; its numerical reads remain approximate because the source is a raster graph.

review_reasoning: The initial force-extension slope is about 78.12 kN/mm, so E=(L0/A0)(dF/dDeltaL) is about 78.1 GPa.
A 0.2% strain offset corresponds to 0.002*200=0.4 mm on the extension axis.
A parallel line offset by 0.4 mm intersects the graph around DeltaL=1.65 mm and Fy=97.53 kN, giving sigma_y about 487.7 MPa.
The graph maximum is about 141.25 kN and occurs near DeltaL=8.04 mm, giving sigma_UTS about 706 MPa and epsilon_UTS about 4.02%.
Final published values must be rounded to graph precision rather than retaining false hundredths.
